example: The operation of this machine is not difficult.
example_zh: 這台機器的操作不難。
memory_hint: oper 表工作，ation 表行為、結果，合起來表示操作、運轉。

example: They opposed their company's new policies.
example_zh: 他們反對公司的新政策。
memory_hint: oppose 表反對、抵制；動詞三態為 oppose, opposed, opposed。

example: Attendance at the exhibition is optional.
example_zh: 這一展覽會可隨意參加。
memory_hint: optional 指可選擇的、非強制的。

example: God has ordained that they should die in poverty. She was ordained the first woman priest of the church last year.
example_zh: 上帝已注定他們窮死於貧困。去年，她被任命為教會的第一位女牧師。
memory_hint: ordain 可指規定、命定，也可指授予聖職。

example: Parliament belongs to the chief organ of government.
example_zh: 國會屬於政府的主要機關。
memory_hint: organ 可指身體器官，也可指組織中的機關、機構。

example: It is a benevolent organization.
example_zh: 這是一個慈善組織。
memory_hint: organization 的名詞複數為 organizations。

example: The outbreak of riot in this area caused a lot of people to die.
example_zh: 這地區暴發騷動使許多人因此喪生。
memory_hint: out + break，字面為向外爆開，引申為爆發。

example: He outlived his wife by several years.
example_zh: 他比妻子多活了幾年。
memory_hint: out- 有超過之意，outlive 即比某人活得更久。

example: Chinese people should never forget the outrage committed by the Japanese invaders.
example_zh: 中國人永遠都不應該忘記日本侵略者犯下的暴行。
memory_hint: outrage 可指暴行、侮辱，也可指強烈憤怒。

example: There is always a gloomy, overcast expression on her face. The existence of evil will overcast your life.
example_zh: 她成天愁眉苦臉。邪惡的存在會使你的人生蒙上陰霾。
chinese: 陰天的；陰暗的；愁悶的；使沮喪
memory_hint: overcast 可作形容詞表示陰沉，也可作動詞表示使蒙上陰影。

example: You must not take an overdose of sleeping pills.
example_zh: 你一定不能服用過量的安眠藥。
memory_hint: over 表超過，dose 表服藥量，合起來即過量服藥。

example: Any man may overextend himself.
example_zh: 每個人都有可能做出不自量力的事。
memory_hint: overextend 指超出能力或資源地延伸、擴張。

example: You must be overly tired.
example_zh: 你一定是太疲倦了。
memory_hint: overly = excessively，表示過度地。

example: Several burglars were easily overpowered by the police.
example_zh: 警方輕而易舉地制服了幾個竊賊。
memory_hint: overpower 指以更強力量壓倒、制服。

example: He has to be on overtime tonight. We have been working overtime.
example_zh: 他今晚得加班。我們近來一直在加班。
memory_hint: over + time，表示超過正常工作時間。

example: You can paint a coat of paint to prevent the oxidation of the ship by seawater.
example_zh: 你們可以刷一層油漆以防止船隻被海水氧化。
memory_hint: oxidation 為 oxide/oxidize 的名詞形式，表示氧化作用。

example: The pollution had destroyed the ozone layer.
example_zh: 污染破壞了臭氧層。
memory_hint: ozone layer 指大氣中的臭氧層。

example: The bus station was packed with noisy pupils. The hikers like to carry packs on their backs.
example_zh: 公共汽車站擠滿了吵吵鬧鬧的小學生。徒步旅行的人喜歡背著包。
memory_hint: pack 可作動詞表示打包、塞滿，也可作名詞表示包、捆。

example: I believe this medicine can palliate your headache.
example_zh: 我相信這藥能緩和你的頭痛。
memory_hint: palliate 指減輕症狀或痛苦，但不一定根治。

example: He palpitated with fear.
example_zh: 他因恐懼而發抖。
memory_hint: palpitate 常指心悸、心跳或因恐懼而顫抖。

example: He was pampering the poor girl's lust for singularity and self-glorification.
example_zh: 由於溺愛和縱容，他就滿足這個可憐女孩追求獨特和自我陶醉的慾望。
memory_hint: pamper 指過度寵愛、縱容。

example: The sudden collapse of the big bank caused a panic on the Stock Exchange.
example_zh: 那家大銀行突然倒閉造成證券交易所的恐慌。
memory_hint: panic 表突然且強烈的恐慌。

example: It's a solid
example_zh: par performance. He had to sell the bond at par.
chinese: 這是一場一般水準的表演。他不得不照票面價值出售債券。
synonyms: 平均的；平常的；同等；票面價值
page: par 指標準、一般水準；at par 指按票面價值。

example: I am willing to enter into partnership with him to do export business.
example_zh: 我願意和他合夥做出口生意。
memory_hint: partnership 指合夥關係或合作關係。

example: I get along very well with him because he is a very patient man. The patient often cried for the pain.
example_zh: 由於他是個很有耐心的人，我和他相處得很融洽。這個病人常因疼痛哭泣。
chinese: 有耐心的；能忍耐的；病人
memory_hint: patient 可作形容詞表示有耐心，也可作名詞表示病人。

example: This is a check payable to the bearer.
example_zh: 這是應付給持票人的支票。
memory_hint: pay + able，表示可支付的、應支付的。

example: He often pays a pedantic attention to details.
example_zh: 他常常學究式地注意細枝末節。
memory_hint: pedantic 指過度賣弄學問、拘泥細節的。

example: A final decision on this matter is pending.
example_zh: 此事還未做最後決定。
memory_hint: pending 指尚未決定或仍在處理中。

example: Helen's mother said that she had no wish to chuck her daughter away on such a penurious person.
example_zh: 海倫的母親說她絕不想把女兒嫁給一個像他這樣貧困的人。
memory_hint: penurious 可指貧窮的，也可指吝嗇的。

example: You can get a percentage on everything they sell.
example_zh: 你可從他們賣出的任何東西獲得一定百分比的金額。
memory_hint: percentage 的名詞複數為 percentages。

example: I should be very glad if you could insert this article into our company's periodical.
example_zh: 如果能把這篇文章登在我們公司的期刊上，我將很高興。
memory_hint: periodical 作名詞表示期刊，複數為 periodicals。

example: One of our company's main problems is the shortage of skilled personnel.
example_zh: 技術人員的短缺是我們公司的一個主要問題。
memory_hint: personnel 是集合名詞，通常視為複數概念。

example: They tried to perturb good social order with their lies and propaganda. She was perturbed by the setback.
example_zh: 他們試圖以謊言和宣傳擾亂良好的社會秩序。她為這次的挫折感到煩惱。
memory_hint: perturb 表擾亂、使焦慮不安。

example: Reformation ideas pervaded the company.
example_zh: 改革的思想遍及公司上下。
memory_hint: pervade 表遍布、滲透；動詞三態為 pervade, pervaded, pervaded。

example: This country is rich with petroleum.
example_zh: 這個國家盛產石油。
memory_hint: petroleum 指石油。

example: I don't understand those physical changes.
example_zh: 我不了解這些物理變化。
memory_hint: physical 可指身體的、物質的或物理的。

example: The doctor suggested her to take less sleeping pills.
example_zh: 醫生建議她少吃些安眠藥。
memory_hint: pill 的名詞複數為 pills。

example: Do you have any piquant sauce?
example_zh: 你有辛辣的調味醬嗎？
memory_hint: piquant 可指味道辛辣，也可指有趣、刺激。

example: 2006 is a pivotal year for the development of the company.
example_zh: 2006年是公司發展的關鍵年。
memory_hint: pivotal 指非常關鍵、起樞紐作用的。

example: Flood had plagued this region for several months. This country suffered many plagues over time.
example_zh: 洪水已經困擾這個地區幾個月了。該國長期遭受許多瘟疫。
memory_hint: plague 可作動詞表示困擾，也可作名詞表示瘟疫、災禍。

example: She was coming by train, so I waited on the platform.
example_zh: 她坐火車來，所以我在月台上等。
memory_hint: platform 可指月台、講台或平台。

example: The plebiscite in Kashmir desired by the UN has never taken place.
example_zh: 聯合國所希望在喀什米爾舉行的公民投票一直未實現。
memory_hint: plebiscite 指公民投票。

example: At present, the pollution had destroyed the ozone layer and caused many changes in weather.
example_zh: 現在，污染破壞了臭氧層並造成許多天氣變化。
memory_hint: pollution 指污染；air pollution 指空氣污染。

example: India has a population explosion at the moment.
example_zh: 印度現正處於人口爆炸的時期。
memory_hint: population 表人口，explosion 表爆炸，合起來即人口激增。

example: Many readers thinks that Dickens portrayed his characters to the life.
example_zh: 許多讀者認為狄更斯把他筆下的人物描繪得栩栩如生。
memory_hint: portray 指描繪、刻畫人物或事物。

example: Liz has acting potential
example_zh: but needs training. Education develops potential abilities.
chinese: 莉斯雖有表演潛力，但還是需要訓練。教育能開發人的潛在能力。
synonyms: 潛力；潛能；潛在的；可能的
page: potential 可作名詞表示潛力，也可作形容詞表示潛在的。

example: We must take precautions against fire.
example_zh: 我們必須對火災採取預防措施。
memory_hint: precaution 指預防措施；複數為 precautions。

example: The woman was pregnant with her first child. I like to read his writings because they are pregnant with poetry.
example_zh: 那位婦女正懷著她的第一個孩子。我喜歡讀他的文章是因為他的文章富有詩意。
memory_hint: pregnant 可指懷孕，也可比喻充滿、富有某種內容。

example: The baby was one month premature. This disease easily produces premature aging of the brain.
example_zh: 這個嬰兒早產一個月。這種疾病易使大腦過早地衰老。
memory_hint: premature 指比正常時間更早發生。

example: He is preparing his report for the meeting tomorrow.
example_zh: 他正準備明天會議的報告。
memory_hint: prepare 表準備、預備。

example: His prescription for economic recovery was well-received.
example_zh: 他為經濟復甦提出的對策反應良好。
memory_hint: prescription 可指醫療處方，也可泛指解決問題的對策。

example: You must make yourself presentable before the interview.
example_zh: 面試前，你得把自己打扮得體面點。
chinese: 拿得出去的；像樣的；體面的
memory_hint: presentable 指外表或狀態得體、可接受。

example: Roosevelt won the 1936 presidential election and became the President.
example_zh: 羅斯福贏得了1936年的總統競選，成為了總統。
memory_hint: presidential 表總統的，election 表選舉。

example: A signed invoice presumes receipt of the shipment.
example_zh: 簽字的發票表示貨物已經收到。
memory_hint: presume 指根據情況推定、假定；動詞三態為 presume, presumed, presumed。

example: These regulations are intended to prevent their plans from being carried out.
example_zh: 這些規章制度意圖阻止他們的計畫被實行。
memory_hint: prevent 常用 prevent ... from ... 表阻止某事發生。

example: I started primary school when I was 6 years old.
example_zh: 我六歲時開始讀小學。
memory_hint: primary 指首要的、初級的。

example: Living conditions in this place are still quite primitive.
example_zh: 這個地方的生活條件仍然很原始。
memory_hint: primitive 指原始、未發展或簡陋的。

example: He feels a prior obligation to his job.
example_zh: 他覺得要優先為他的工作盡職。
chinese: 居先的；優先的；更重要的
memory_hint: prior 常接介系詞 to，表示在…之前或優先於。

example: I felt I needed privacy.
example_zh: 我覺得我需要清靜。
memory_hint: privacy 表隱私、私人空間或清靜。

example: He proclaimed that they were traitors.
example_zh: 他宣稱他們是叛徒。
memory_hint: proclaim 指公開、正式宣布。

example: He tells me that he can procure the rare old book for me.
example_zh: 他告訴我他能為我購得那本罕見的舊書。
memory_hint: procure 指設法取得、獲得。

example: They will come here in search of new markets for their products.
example_zh: 他們將要來此為他們的產品尋找新的市場。
memory_hint: product 指製成品、成果或結果。

example: He is a highly professional administrator.
example_zh: 他是一位非常專業的管理人員。
memory_hint: professional 指專業的、職業性的。

example: The firm is a highly profitable business.
example_zh: 該公司是個獲利豐厚的企業。
chinese: 有利的；有益的；可賺錢的
memory_hint: profitable 指能帶來利益或利潤的。

example: The new project will be completed next year. They are projecting a new dam.
example_zh: 這項新的工程將於明年完工。他們正規劃新的堤壩。
memory_hint: project 可作名詞表示計畫、工程，也可作動詞表示規劃、投射。

example: It is well known that he is a prominent entrepreneur.
example_zh: 眾所周知，他是一位卓越的企業家。
memory_hint: prominent 指顯著、突出的或傑出的。

example: This year's sales promotions of our company haven't been very successful.
example_zh: 今年我們公司的促銷活動不是很成功。
memory_hint: promotion 可指促進、升遷或促銷活動。

example: They want to start a newspaper to propagate their ideas.
example_zh: 他們想辦一份報紙來宣傳他們的主張。
memory_hint: propagate 表傳播、宣傳或繁殖；動詞三態為 propagate, propagated, propagated。

example: He was prosecuted for fraud.
example_zh: 他因詐欺被起訴。
memory_hint: prosecute 指依法起訴、追訴。

example: Eating more high protein diet is good for health.
example_zh: 多吃蛋白質含量高的食物對健康有益。
memory_hint: protein 指蛋白質。

example: The agreement provides that one-month notice shall be given on either side.
example_zh: 這項協議規定任何一方應在一個月前發出通知。
memory_hint: provide 可表示提供，也可表示條款規定。

example: He will be proxy for me.
example_zh: 他將是我的代理人。
memory_hint: proxy 可指代理人、代理權；複數為 proxies。

example: The public relations firm will handle all our publicity.
example_zh: 公關公司將處理我們的全部宣傳工作。
memory_hint: public relations 指公共關係、公關工作。

example: He purchased this car at an auction.
example_zh: 他在拍賣會中購買這輛車。
memory_hint: purchase 可作動詞或名詞，表示購買。

example: Each one in our company has his quota of work for the day.
example_zh: 我們公司每個人都有一天的工作配額。
memory_hint: quota 指配額、定額或限額；複數為 quotas。

example: Your views are very radical.
example_zh: 你的觀點非常激進。
memory_hint: radical 可指根本的，也可指激進的。

example: He has never been a radiologist.
example_zh: 他不曾做過放射線專家。
chinese: 放射線學者；放射科醫師
memory_hint: radiologist 指放射線專家或放射科醫師。
